decisions.rationale: 'meningococcal meningitis' names one specific disease with a single definition and no further categorization.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease mentions

decisions.rationale: 'absence of the sixth component of complement' describes one specific condition, C6 deficiency, which is a named disease rather than a general term, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease mentions; Examples 6 (C7 deficiency)

decisions.rationale: Second occurrence of 'meningococcal meningitis' in the abstract; duplicate mentions are annotated separately, so it is a Specific Disease like candidate 1.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 - Annotate duplicate mentions

decisions.rationale: Duplicate occurrence of 'absence of the sixth component of complement' in the abstract, referring to the same specific C6 deficiency condition, so it is annotated as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 - Annotate duplicate mentions

decisions.rationale: 'C6' is the abbreviation defined for 'absence of the sixth component of complement' and is a synonymous mention of the same specific disease, so it is annotated separately as a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 6 - Annotate all synonymous mentions

decisions.rationale: 'recurrent neisserial infections' refers to a family of infections caused by Neisseria species (e.g., meningococcal and gonococcal disease), so it is a group of multiple specific diseases rather than one.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class; Examples 10 and 11 (family of diseases)

decisions.rationale: 'C6 deficiency' names one specific inherited complement deficiency disease with a particular form, analogous to 'C7 deficiency', so it is a Specific Disease.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 1 - Specific Disease; Examples 6 (C7 deficiency)

decisions.rationale: 'C6-deficient' is a disease mention used as an adjective modifying the noun 'serum' ('her C6-deficient serum'), so it is annotated as a Modifier.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 3 - Disease mentions used as Modifiers

decisions.rationale: Duplicate occurrence of 'recurrent neisserial infections' in the abstract; it refers to the same family of Neisseria infections and is annotated as a Disease Class.
decisions.guideline_section: What to Annotate 4 - Annotate duplicate mentions; What to Annotate 1 - Disease Class

decisions.rationale: 'absence of one of the late-acting complement components' refers to a family of possible deficiencies (any one of several late complement components), so it is a Disease Class rather than a single specific disease.
